source.caption: Predicted versus actual throughput (Mbps) for all five regression models. Each panel shows predictions against ground-truth values with the 45° ideal line on the full mixed-scenario test set (all six scenario types, including out-of-distribution samples). Annotations in each panel ( R 2 , RMSE) therefore reflect mixed-scenario performance; in-distribution metrics are reported in Table 2 . The lower ANN R 2 visible here (≈0.75) is attributable to RMa out-of-distribution samples (see Table 5) and is not inconsistent with R 2 = 0.998 in Table 2 , which uses the matched in-distribution test split.
